g.text: 1. Product Overview
1.1 Business Model — How Nikharta Roop Earns Money
Nikharta Roop is a multi-channel beauty parlour business that operates both through physical
walk-in customers and a digital booking platform. The platform enables customers to discover
services, book appointments, and leave reviews — all in Hindi.
Revenue Stream
Description
Example
Service Revenue
Customers pay for beauty services (haircut, facial, bridal makeup)
Bridal package ₹8,000
Advance Booking Fee
10–20% advance collected during online booking to prevent no-shows
₹500 advance on ₹2,500 package
Premium Packages
Combo packages at discounted rates to increase order value
Bridal combo: makeup + mehendi + facial
Seasonal Offers
Festival discounts (Diwali, Eid, Navratri) drive volume
20% off on Diwali week
Loyalty Points
Repeat customers earn points redeemable on next visit
₹200 saved on 5th visit
Multi-Branch Scale
Franchise or company-owned branches in multiple cities
Branches in Delhi, Lucknow, Jaipur
Product Sales
Beauty products sold at parlour or via app
Skincare kits, hair oils
1.2 Target User Personas
Understanding our users is critical for building the right features. Below are four
real-world personas representing our core audience.
Persona
Age
Location
Device
Goal
Pain Point
College Girl — Priya
Tier-2 city (Kanpur)
Budget Android phone
Quick haircut or threading before college event
Long queues, uncertain wait time
Working Woman — Sunita
Metro (Delhi, Noida)
Mid-range Android
Book facial on weekend without going in person
No time to call, uncertain slot availability
Bride-to-Be — Kavita
Any city
Android + sometimes desktop
Book complete bridal package months in advance
Wants to compare packages, scared of last-minute cancellation
Homemaker — Rekha
Small town (Bareilly)
Basic Android
Book monthly facial or hair spa nearby
Prefers Hindi UI, not comfortable with English apps
Salon Admin — Pooja
Parlour location
Tablet/Desktop + Mobile
Manage daily bookings, staff, and services
Overwhelmed by phone calls, no cancellation visibility
1.3 User Journeys
Journey A: First-Time User Flow (New Customer — Priya)
• Priya searches 'beauty parlour near me' on Google → lands on Nikharta Roop website.
• She sees the Home page in Hindi with services listed and an attractive banner.
• She clicks 'Services' → browses 'Threading' under 'Face Care' category.
• She clicks 'Book Now' → prompted to login. She enters her mobile number.
• OTP received via SMS → she enters it → account auto-created.
• She selects date, time slot, and preferred staff (optional).
• She sees the summary: Service + Price + Time → pays ₹50 advance via UPI.
• Booking Confirmed screen appears. WhatsApp message received instantly.
• Day of appointment: she receives a reminder SMS 2 hours before.
• Post-service: she receives a link to leave a review.
Journey B: Repeat Customer Flow (Sunita — Working Woman)
• Sunita opens the Nikharta Roop app on Sunday morning.
• She is already logged in (token saved). Home page shows her last service.
• She taps 'Book Again' on her previous 'Facial' service — date picker opens.
• She selects next Saturday, 11 AM slot — sees it's available.
• She confirms booking — no payment needed (loyalty discount applied).
• Booking appears in 'My Appointments' immediately.
Journey C: Bride-to-Be Flow (Kavita)
• Kavita opens the website on her laptop 3 months before wedding.
• She navigates to 'Bridal Packages' category — sees detailed package cards.
• She reads descriptions, views photo gallery of previous work.
• She books a 'Pre-Bridal Consultation' slot first (free) to discuss requirements.
• Admin confirms the consultation booking via Admin Panel.
• After consultation, admin creates a custom bridal package for Kavita.
• Kavita receives WhatsApp with full package breakdown and payment link.
• She pays 30% advance — booking is locked.
